# RCMI Attendance Checker Demo by P-Devs

> Interactive portfolio demo for member attendance recording and administration.

## Canonical URL

- [Open the demo](https://rcmi-demo.pauuu.dev/)
- [Visit the P-Devs portfolio](https://pauuu.dev/)

## Demo behavior

- The app contains fictional sample member and attendance data for evaluation.
- Visitor-created data resets every day at 12:00 AM Asia/Manila.
- The administrator preview is available by manually opening `/administrator`.
- Do not enter real or sensitive information.
